caveat: Static source discovery is a bounded candidate inventory. Every currently known product-owned dynamic factory and native contribution is represented by an explicit route row or registered surface, and no known current product-owned control remains untraced. This does not prove future, third-party, operating-system, or otherwise undiscovered runtime controls are mapped. Shared implementation aliases remain separately bound surface contexts but should reuse one implementation proof where truthful.
